scope: Independent first full exact v9 encoded review. Full narration/source/every chapter inspected, no material visual blocker. No continuous sound, native Apple or publication approval.

lessons.reason: Complete185-line delivered narration and766-line animation personally read, every25 authored chapter sheet plus brand personally viewed,11 registered natives and24 exact MP4 states personally inspected. All397 artifacts and four current/frozen pairs match. Fixed-universe ranking/recall, live MMR subtraction, actual nine-pair gradients,600step fit and temporal holdouts, observed exposure versus expected clicks, immutable response/outcome joins and a changed-stock fresh replay provide substantial causal construction. Every inspected completed answer follows its complete provider result clause. No material blocker found. Expanded lineage/experiment/receipt panels and short gradient/test payoffs retain honest craft deductions. This is a complete narration/source and sampled encoded visual review, not continuous sound or publication approval.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A label-printer catalog retains eligibility, relevance and record identities through a concrete ranking task.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The opening establishes explicit examples, while its funnel diagram remains a reference introduction.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Candidate and display cutoffs remain distinct; a separate MMR worksheet retains selectedP5 while live redundancy subtraction changes the next winner fromP6 toP4.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Live subtraction labels follow live quantities and the completed winner waits for the entire result clause.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: High-match P8/P11 fail policy/region while lower-match eligible products flow into the shortlist.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Product identities and rejection causes persist; ranking score never creates permission.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: First-failure diagnostics, seller concentration and a changed current-stock flag each enforce their own slate boundary.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The old high score remains fixed while current eligibility changes; historical rows remain bound to their original catalog.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The same three product identities move from grades1/3/2 to3/2/1; contributions and fixed ideal normalization recompute after commitment.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The moving order is explicitly in transit, and final positions/calculations agree.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Gain, discount, fixed ideal, binary recall and reciprocal rank use separate grade and denominator contracts.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Grade1 still owns DCG gain despite falling below the supplied binary-relevance threshold. Some final metric panels settle as references.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Removing relevant P6 before ranking leaves a perfect survivor order but loses half of eligible relevant products.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The physical missing identity remains outside the slate and fixed-universe normalization exposes the loss.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Per-query regressions, absent eligible products and a supplied nearest-rank latency worksheet retain distinct release conditions.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Synthetic18ms is explicitly supplied rather than measured; it is scoped to scoring rather than whole search.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A separate twelve-step two-feature illustration moves the preference boundary and reversesP5/P4 scores.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The direction and scores use the same weights; this illustration is explicitly separate from the actual CSV objective fit.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The actual A2−A1 feature difference supplies zero-score sigmoid, gradient, updated weights and positive margin.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The completed weight/margin answer waits for its full clause. Its payoff lasts only about1.1seconds before the next chapter.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: All nine actual directed preferences contribute head-to-tail numerator increments before averaging and the first update.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The partial numerator follows precisely the completed pairs and fractional next pair, rather than a decorative precomputed arrow.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The same pending outcome moves beyond the strict training freeze, preventing a future label from entering an earlier row.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Feature, serving and eventual-label clocks remain separate; unresolved outcomes are not fabricated final negatives.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Eight three-product request groups carry serving and label clocks through strict train/validation/test freezes.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The entire request group stays together, with three train/two validation/two test and one pending group.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Two actual600step candidates fit nine preferences; validation selects the penalized weights before the later held-out ranking is disclosed.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Independent reproduction matches fitted weights and both perfect later rankings. The final test payoff has a short roughly1.1second dwell.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: One hundred/twenty/ten actual authored impressions expose ten/six/four clicks; equal exposure changes the tempting raw-count comparison.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Each mark represents one impression and the observed rate denominators remain explicit.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Supplied examination and relevance generate expected clicks; inverse weighting recovers.5 under the assumption while clipping caps the lower-position expectation at.2.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Bars and current weighted labels share the same state. Expected toy quantities remain distinct from finite observed clicks.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Positive known logging propensities, overlap and declared clipping limits distinguish identified estimates from unavailable counterfactual evidence.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Accurate scoped conditions are mostly taught through expanded reference panels.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The concrete R42 response preserves learned scores and physically copies the actual selected order into a saved snapshot.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Saved product/rank identity persists; policy-blocked products cannot re-enter because they score well.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Retained server proposals preserve product positions and request/model/catalog identities while returned/rendered/visible/examined remain distinct receipts.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The record contracts are explicit but settle as long reference panels; no client-view acknowledgment is invented.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Clicks and purchases join retained request+product; an unexposed product, earlier timestamp and changed replay payload each meet their own rejection branch.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The original saved order remains immutable; serial examples are not claimed to implement a durable deduplicator.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Stable experiment+shopper assignment groups repeated searches under one unit and keeps readiness, stopping and recovery evidence separate.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Assignment identity is visible, with several later experiment planning conditions taught as settled contract references.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Pairwise ordering is kept separate from calibrated click/purchase probabilities; the supplied chain yields4currency units and an empirical single-bin gap.2.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: All probability/value denominators are visible and costs/other paths are explicitly outside the supplied gross-value worksheet.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Independent100search cohorts show improving conversion while the distinct return guardrail stops treatment; zero control purchases leave an undefined comparison.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The completed stop waits for its complete clause. No real experiment or significance claim is made.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Seventeen local gates, actual temporal fit, supplied latency and authored online aggregates remain separate evidence ledgers.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The explicit boundary prevents a local pass from pretending to be a live experiment, though the ledger panels are long reference holds.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Separate completed dot products earn J2/J3/J1; changed stock excludesJ3, a separately scoredJ5 enters, and the rebuilt response retainsJ2/J5/J1.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The initial prediction remains neutral; individual numeric/order outcomes follow their complete clauses and the same product objects enact the repair.
